job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year agreement (audits of fiscal year ending June 30, 2023 and the two subsequent fiscal years), subject to annual Board review; the original term may be extended for up to an additional three years by mutual agreement of KCERA and the firm.
job.acceptance: Accept 3+up to3 years, mutual extension. Audit fiscal years and annual-review/negotiation detail need not all be volunteered.

reviews.reason: This is a Texas Municipal Retirement System RFP for investment consulting, not KCERA’s audit-services RFP. It does not support the specified three-year audit agreement or mutual option to extend it for up to three additional years.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (“RFP”) is being issued by the Texas Municipal Retirement System (“TMRS”).
The purpose of this RFP is for TMRS to seek proposals for services from qualified general investment consultants
The term of the contract will cover a multi-year period to be negotiated during final contract negotiations.
